label: Text 1
transcript: Theo opens the front door. The hallway smells of bread and rain. To the right is the kitchen, with its loud fridge and quiet kettle. The living room has a large window onto the courtyard. Down the hall is Mia's bedroom — door always almost shut, never quite open. Frida the fox arrives at the back door, wet and polite. "I won't go in," she says. "I just like to be invited."
